name: 74010 · Bristow, OK
findings: ZIP 74010 (Bristow) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74010 (Bristow) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
83% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
